messages.subject: Re: Sequenza 3.0.0 is out
messages.body_plain:
Hi Francesco,

I was trying to install the new version and encountered errors installing seqminer (a new dependency that is required by Sequenza). The newest version of seqminer requires R >=v3.5. Can you please let us know which version of seqminer is compatible with the current version of Sequenza or update the CRAN dependency for Sequenza to reflect the change? Currently, it shows on CRAN that R >= v3.2 is required for Sequenza.

Thanks for updating the Sequenza package and providing on going support.
Best,
Cindy

On Thursday, May 9, 2019 at 10:44:33 AM UTC-4, Francesco Favero wrote:
> New sequenza release is on CRAN now.
>
> Changes since 2.1.2:
>
>  - Code cleanup and refactoring
>  - Bug fixes
>  - Use readr and stop relying on system commands (grep, sed, gunzip) to read seqz files
>  - Use the package pbapply for progress bar
>  - Normalize each sample separately
>  - Provide coverage profile of the 2 samples separately, before and after normalization
>  - Provide CG-content vs depth profile for each samples, before and after normalization
>  - Draw standard "mirrored" BAF (from 0 to 1) in the raw genome view
>
> Also sequenza-utils 3.0.0 is on pypi, it is compatible with python 2.7/3. It adds support from VCF to seqz files and varius cleanup and bug fixes.
>
> All in all the 3.0.0 realease works much better then the legacy version. I strongly encourage to upgrade :-).
>
> I hope you'll enjoy the new release.
>
> Best
>
> Francesco

messages.subject: Re: Add annotation
messages.body_plain:
Found the answer... Just use R to convert the file "output_segments.txt" to .bed format and use AnnotSV to annotate!

Em segunda-feira, 27 de maio de 2019 16:49:31 UTC-3, Bruno Batista de Souza escreveu:
> Hi everyone,
>
> I run all the sequenza jobs with no problems but now, I need to annotate my CNVs and this is beeing a real trouble. Does anyone know how to do this task?
>
> Thanks.
messages.body_snippet:
Found the answer... Just use R to convert the file "output_segments.txt" to .bed format and use AnnotSV to annotate!
